title: Queue: the two translation-bundle lint gates red only in the merge queue, so a PR that declares an untranslated label passes its own CI and ejects its stack (6 ejections on 2026-11-08)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ① a measured, repeated queue red. The rule 「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」 applies. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

PR 新加了显示标签却没补翻译时，PR 自己的 CI 不跑翻译这两道检查（只跑受影响的那部分），要到合并队列跑全量才发现。于是这个 PR 被挤出，排在它后面的 PR 也一起被重建。今天已发生 6 次，每次都是单个 PR 自己的问题，但拖累了整个队列。

## Measured (2026-11-08, `Lint & Type Check` on `merge_group`)

| Time (UTC) | Group head PR | Gates red |
|---|---|---|
| 08:40 | #31445 | both translation gates |
| 08:57 | #31282, #31329 | both |
| 09:01 | #31455 | both |
| 11:11 | #31448 | both. The log: `packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts: untranslated declared strings grew 0 → 6` |
| 11:13 | #31484 | both (stacked behind #31448; green on its own re-build at 11:25) |

Each group after a fix or an ejection went green. `main` push `Lint & Type Check` stayed green throughout, so push-side lint does not run these two steps for those diffs either.

## Ask

- Find why a PR whose diff declares a label (`platform-objects` objects, settings manifests, spec-declared labels) does not run these two steps on its own `pull_request` CI. Either the steps' `if:` / path filters miss those paths, or the lane is affected-only and these steps sit outside the affected set.
- Make the PR-side run reach them for such diffs, using the steps that already exist; no new gate. Also derive them in `dispatch-gates --commands` (the #31257 family), so a dev runs them before the report.
- Pin: a diff that adds one untranslated declared label reds on PR CI. CONTROL: a diff that touches no declared label does not run them.

## Not measured

- The exact trigger condition of the two steps for `pull_request` events, in `lint.yml` (`id: check-generated-translation-bundles` ≈L6361, `check-no-new-untranslated-declared-labels` ≈L6378).

Lane: `domain:devx` (`.github/workflows/**` wiring and `dispatch-gates`). Related: #31257, #31444, PR #31448.
